anti_regression_invariants.rule: TOKEN_VAZIO is an explicit epistemic state and must never be coerced to zero, false, null, PASS, FAIL or RESOLVED.
Every unresolved item requires authority, owner, provenance, next_action, exit_criterion and falsifier.
A resolution or evidenced state requires non-empty evidence_refs tied to an observable artifact or run.
Evidence is bounded to the exact repository, ref or commit, path or artifact, and observation represented by its reference.
Urgency changes execution order only; urgency never upgrades evidence quality or claim truth.
A mutating high-risk or critical action requires explicit rollback or recovery provenance before execution.
Evidence from one commit, build, APK, dataset, protocol version or device must not be silently inherited by another.
Claims requiring physical Android, Termux, VM or device execution remain TOKEN_VAZIO until a physical runtime receipt exists.
Cross-repository protocol compatibility requires both producer and consumer contract evidence for the same protocol version.
Gap closure is append-only at the evidence layer; corrections supersede prior receipts instead of rewriting historical observations.
READY_TO_TEST means implementation exists but the exit criterion has not yet been observed; it is not RESOLVED.
Negative evidence may close a hypothesis as RESOLVED_NEGATIVE and must not be converted into a positive success claim.
